subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI render remote http/https Markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and under what trust policy if it should?
rationale: Current code, tests, docs, and merged hardening intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches, while the requested UX would change that security boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, local blob/data images, or an explicitly approved proxy/opt-in design before rendering remote images.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the privacy and tracking tradeoff, then update renderer, sanitizer attributes, CSP, docs, tests, and real browser proof together.

options.title: Fold into inline media policy
options.body: Let the broader inline-media work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/64607 explicitly accept or reject remote Markdown images before this focused behavior changes.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, local blob/data images, or an explicitly approved proxy/opt-in design before rendering remote images.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the Control UI browser-fetch and CSP security policy that this owner most directly touched in merged history.
